11_application_rlc_data_rates.png: Application offered load is capture-binned SFD4 payload, not a T-tracer application event. PDCP ingress and RLC dequeue are decoded directly from each ue.raw recording. P50/P99 refer to complete one-second rate bins; the final partial second is excluded from bin statistics. RLC ingress is also exported in TRANSPORT_RATES_1S.csv. Protocol-layer byte counts are deliberately not labelled equal to application goodput.
12_rlc_and_gnb_buffer_time.png: RLC buffer occupancy is an actual UE-side MAC read of RLC before grant multiplexing. The separate gNB series comes from GNB_MAC_UL_MCS_DECISION.estimated_ul_buffer at telemetry ingest time. Its median sits at 0.30 MB for both static arms despite their very different actual RLC queues; it must not substitute for UE occupancy. Direct post-multiplex BSR/LCG state and BSR report frequency cannot be recovered: NRUE_MAC_BSR_STATUS has zero records in these recordings. Do not interpret occupancy derivatives as throughput.
